meta.source: Started from ink and butter (github.com/limiteinductive/inknb, src/tokens.css at 2026-11-02) and then tuned for this product. It is a reference, not a constraint.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of the whole app: the thread and the page sit directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the composer, aside cards, cards in the thread.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, on paper and surface. Also the fill of the run clock and of a shown evidence chip.

tokens.name: ink-1
tokens.usage: Primary emphasis ink: prompts, math, headings, strong text, bare inline symbols.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Sustained reading ink: all body prose, explanations, and learner replies.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: metadata, timestamps, section titles, quiet controls. Never dimmed further with opacity.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the trace line, timestamps, sub-lines, placeholders. Reads at 4.5:1 or better on paper, surface, human-message-surface, hover and annotation-surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Borders of cards and controls, dividers between days.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a card, table row rules.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed wash on quiet controls.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent, ink blue. Send button, text buttons, links, the tutor's name in an aside, the scope line of the composer. Never decoration, never a ground for running text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icon or text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground, for example the hover state of an accent text button.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: The rule beside a quoted passage in an aside.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px outline on keyboard focus, offset by 2px. At least 4.9:1 on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The learner's own text selection, and the passage an aside they started is anchored to.

tokens.name: human-message-surface
tokens.usage: Ground of the learner's messages in the thread.

tokens.name: passage-highlight
tokens.usage: Resting highlight on a passage that has an aside.

tokens.name: passage-focus
tokens.usage: Highlight on the passage the tutor is asking about.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The identity colour beside ink blue. The cover and any future mark. Never text, and never a ground for text: unit cards use unit-surface.

tokens.name: source
tokens.usage: Butter, as text. The label of a unit card.

tokens.name: source-wash
tokens.usage: Butter, as ground. The surface of a unit card, and a missed evidence chip.

tokens.name: unit-label
tokens.usage: Semantic name for the label of a unit card.

tokens.name: unit-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic name for the ground of a unit card.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: A miss or the costly step in a debrief, as text or as a timeline segment. A miss is not an error, so it never uses danger.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and real failures only, such as a failed code run.

tokens.name: annotation-surface
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: code blocks and the problem statement of a timed run.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Semantic name for the ground of a code block.

tokens.name: annotation-edge
tokens.usage: Edge of a recessed surface, the outline of a not-yet chip and of a paused clock, the dashed border of a noted unit.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, monospace

roles.name: display
roles.usage: Sign-in, open exploration heading, sitting complete.

roles.name: prompt
roles.usage: Active drill prompt; balanced wrapping, max 34em.

roles.name: body
roles.usage: All tutor, explore, and briefing prose; pretty wrapping, max 68ch.

roles.name: body-sm
roles.usage: Solutions, follow-ups, added-to-practice, inline pins, secondary prose.

roles.name: code
roles.usage: Code blocks, learner derivations, and in-place derivation editor on one grid.

roles.name: code-inline
roles.usage: Inline code inside any role (bare when <=3 chars, chip otherwise).

roles.name: label
roles.usage: Buttons, controls, tabs, and sidebar items.

roles.name: meta
roles.usage: Section headers, tags, timers, counts, and traces (tabular-nums).

styles.name: thread-body
styles.sample: Which single multiply-and-divide turns it back into an expectation?
styles.usage: Every message in the thread, tutor and learner.

styles.name: page-body
styles.sample: A baseline is a number we subtract from the reward before multiplying.

styles.name: page-title
styles.sample: Why a baseline keeps the estimator unbiased
styles.usage: The one title of a page.

styles.name: page-math
styles.sample: E[b ∇ log p] = b E[∇ log p]
styles.usage: Displayed math on a page, one step per line.

styles.name: unit-statement
styles.sample: A baseline must not depend on the sample.
styles.usage: The statement of a unit on its card.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: The quoted passage at the top of an aside.

styles.name: aside-body
styles.sample: You moved b(x) outside the expectation here. What made that legal in step 1?

styles.name: trace
styles.usage: The grey line after a review, sub-lines on cards, day dividers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on cards and asides.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The run clock. Always with tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to its text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a control and its neighbour.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between messages of one turn. Padding of a learner message.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The content gutter of every card, and the side gutter on a phone.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between turns, and between the page and the margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a day divider.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Text buttons, the plus button, highlights on a passage.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, asides, the composer, learner messages, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The send button, evidence chips, the run clock.

tokens.name: elevation-card
tokens.usage: Aside cards and the composer. Nothing in the thread itself is raised.

tokens.name: elevation-panel
tokens.usage: A dialog, if one is ever needed.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the thread column and of the text column of a page.

tokens.name: aside-width
tokens.usage: Width of the margin beside a page.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest touch target.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Visual height of a text button. Its hit area still reaches target-min.
